parsed.why: No criminalisation, constitutional equality guarantee, no documented police or border targeting of trans visitors; only dated stigma. Thin but structurally positive record, with no acceptance tradition or shown enforcement of protections.

State actors are perpetrators: police raids and collective detention, trans women sexually abused in custody, conversion rape with official impunity, LGBT organiser detained 2023. Vagrancy law applied despite formal non-criminalisation.

Indecency powers used against cross-dressing, deportation power over non-citizens, documented airport screening barring 'effeminate' entrants, Sharia-based gender-recognition refusal, no protections, decade of blocked research. Border exposure hits every visible visitor.

Marriage equality, self-ID, hate-speech and equal-treatment law, attackers convicted and 21 mob members arrested, working custody-transfer route including for a foreign national. Residual street hostility and dated police mistreatment keep it from the top.

No express offence, but morality provisions make public conduct de facto prosecutable, no general discrimination remedy, no recognition, unregistrable organisations, pervasive religious intolerance. No documented trans violence, yet thin record blocks credit for silence.
